recommended.variant: Native dialog.showModal with visible title, real background inertness, deliberate initial focus, contained navigation, Escape, deterministic focus return, and only short optional descriptions.

entries.behavior: APG requires actual modality, accessible naming, initial and returned focus, contained Tab navigation, Escape, and omission of large structured aria-describedby content.
entries.source_date: living document; no publication date shown
entries.decision: Use native showModal with APG naming/focus and real inertness; never use aria-modal as a substitute for behavior.

entries.behavior: CANDIDATE Modal Dialog report: 83 MUST assertions passed, 0 failed; multiple moderate and severe excessive-verbosity side effects were recorded, including repeated controls and dialog content. MUST counts exclude ARIA-AT's per-command negative-side-effect assertions; side effects are reported separately.
entries.source_date: results completed through 2024-06-24; test plan V24.06.07
entries.decision: Keep short descriptions and structured-content initial focus; test actual speech despite all MUST assertions passing.

entries.behavior: CANDIDATE Modal Dialog report: 83 MUST assertions passed, 0 failed, and no negative side effects recorded. MUST counts exclude ARIA-AT's per-command negative-side-effect assertions; side effects are reported separately.
entries.source_date: results completed through 2025-12-23; test plan V24.06.07
entries.decision: Retain native showModal and APG focus/naming.

entries.behavior: CANDIDATE Modal Dialog report: 50 MUST assertions passed and 14 failed; two severe side effects recorded cursors not moving to the intended position/control. MUST counts exclude ARIA-AT's per-command negative-side-effect assertions; side effects are reported separately.
entries.source_date: results completed through 2024-06-18; test plan V24.06.07
entries.decision: Verify initial focus, containment, and return in the current real VoiceOver lane; do not transfer the old JAWS pass.

entries.behavior: The historical APG modal matrix reports failure both for conveying aria-modal presence and for limiting reading to dialog children; aria-modal alone therefore leaves background content reachable in this observation.
entries.decision: Native showModal and actual inertness/focus containment are mandatory; do not rely on aria-modal alone on Android.

entries.behavior: The historical matrix passes aria-modal presence but reports only partial reading containment for this pair; current background reachability remains pending.
entries.decision: Use actual native inertness and verify swipe/rotor background exclusion on current iOS.

entries.behavior: NVDA 17352 reported reading all dialog content without aria-describedby; it was closed and converted to discussion 17395 on 2024-11-12. This is a historical verbosity lead, not an open current defect.
entries.decision: Test short and structured description variants; do not add a large description as a universal workaround.

entries.behavior: JAWS 662 reports announcing the entire dialog the first time a button is focused; duplicate report 700 was closed on 2023-06-01. Issue 662 was closed as wontfix, not a JAWS bug; the maintainer's resolution was to give the dialog an accessible name with aria-labelledby, which the recommended variant already requires. This is a verbosity observation, not evidence against native showModal.
entries.decision: Use short optional descriptions and content-dependent initial focus; test actual JAWS output.
